title: A Survey of Baker Wandering Domains
summary: Let $f:\mathbb C\to \widehat{\mathbb C}=\mathbb C \cup\{\infty\}$ be a transcendental meromorphic function (possibly without any pole) with a single essential singularity, and that is chosen to be at $\infty$. The set of points $z\in\mathbb{\widehat{C}}$ such that the family of iterates $\{f^n\}_{n\geq 0}$ is defined and forms a normal family in a neighborhood of $z$ is known as the Fatou set of $f$.
